QuestInfo.name: Humanoid A wants a Baby
QuestInfo.0: Humanoid A has a strange appearance. Quite different from a normal person actually. Go speak with Humanoid A.
QuestInfo.1: Humanoid A wants a baby. But robots can't have babies right? Maybe #bHan the Broker#k has a solution to this.
QuestInfo.2: Han the Broker gives you #t4033849# so that Humanoid A can have a baby.

1.0: Do you really think I can have a child?
